items.text: Ostranauts had a pretty rough launch, but the game has come a LONGGG way since then. Many improvements, bug fixes, and overall quality of life changes has occurred since launch. I'm very impressed on where the game has come so far, and I can't wait for what the future has to offer for this game.
items.text_zh: Ostranauts 的发布相当艰难，但自那以后这款游戏已经走了很长很长一段路。自发布以来，出现了许多改进、bug 修复以及整体生活质量方面的变化。我对这款游戏目前取得的进展印象非常深刻，我迫不及待想看到这款游戏的未来会带来什么。
